title: Client Project Brief
intro: Initial Project Assessment and Requirements Gathering

saveStatus.conflict: A newer saved version is available. Your local changes have not been overwritten.
saveStatus.unavailable: This questionnaire session is no longer available
saveStatus.discardAndReload: Discard local changes and load saved version

1.title: Client Information and Project Overview
1.description: Tell us who you are, what the project is called and the business need behind it.

2.title: Goals and Target Audience
2.description: Describe the intended outcomes, audience and measures of success.

3.title: Content and Structure
3.description: Outline the planned content, available materials and required languages.

4.title: Design and Visual Identity
4.description: Share the visual direction, references and anything the project should avoid.

5.title: Features and Technical Requirements
5.description: Select requested functionality and describe existing systems or constraints.

6.title: Timeline and Budget
6.description: Share preferred dates, relevant deadlines, priorities and an indicative budget.

7.title: Notes, Review and Final Confirmation
7.description: Add any remaining notes and review all answers before the future submission stage.

existingWebsite.label: Existing Website
existingWebsite.help: Enter a domain or full web address. HTTPS is added automatically when omitted.

businessDescription.label: Business Description
businessDescription.help: Brief description of the company, its products or services.

primaryNeed.label: Primary Need
primaryNeed.help: What problem or business need prompted the Client to request this project?

mainObjectives.label: Main Objectives
mainObjectives.help: Describe the results the Client wants to achieve.

targetAudience.label: Target Audience
targetAudience.help: Select all audiences the website or service is intended for.

desiredUserActions.label: Desired User Actions
desiredUserActions.help: Select all actions visitors should be able to take.

successCriteria.label: Success Criteria
successCriteria.help: How will the project's effectiveness be evaluated?

plannedPagesOrSections.label: Planned Pages or Sections
plannedPagesOrSections.help: Home, About Us, Services, Contact, etc.

contentResponsibilities.label: Content Responsibilities
contentResponsibilities.help: Who will provide the final text, images and other materials?

requiredLanguages.label: Required Languages
requiredLanguages.help: Select all languages that may be required.

preferredStyle.label: Preferred Style
preferredStyle.help: Select every visual direction that feels appropriate.

referenceWebsites.label: Reference Websites
referenceWebsites.help: URLs and elements the Client particularly likes.

elementsToAvoid.label: Elements to Avoid
elementsToAvoid.help: Styles, colours or features the Client does not want.

domainAndHosting.label: Domain and Hosting
domainAndHosting.help: Already available / To be purchased / To be confirmed.

existingSystems.label: Existing Systems
existingSystems.help: CMS, databases, third-party services or tools requiring integration.

specialRequirements.label: Special Requirements
specialRequirements.help: Accessibility, performance, security or other constraints.

indicativeBudget.label: Indicative Budget
indicativeBudget.help: Amount or budget range, if provided.

projectPriorities.label: Project Priorities
projectPriorities.help: Essential features and potential future developments.

additionalNotes.label: Additional Notes
additionalNotes.help: Relevant information discussed during the initial consultation.

pointsRequiringClarification.label: Points Requiring Clarification
pointsRequiringClarification.help: Missing requirements, pending decisions or matters requiring further investigation.

agreedNextStep.label: Agreed Next Step
agreedNextStep.help: Preparation of the Commercial Proposal, follow-up meeting, collection of materials, etc.

finalConfirmation.label: I have reviewed the information shown above.
finalConfirmation.help: This confirms only that you have reviewed the local questionnaire. It does not save or submit any information.

requestedFeatures.description: Third-party integrations connect the project to services operated by another provider, such as booking, payment or customer-management tools.

domainAndHosting.description: A domain name is the web address people use to find the site. Hosting is the service that keeps the website available online.

existingSystems.description: A CMS is a content management system used to edit website content. List any CMS, database or external service the new project must work with.

specialRequirements.description: Technical requirements may include accessibility, performance, security or SEO. SEO helps search engines understand and display website content.

validation.date: Enter a valid date in dd/mm/yyyy format.
validation.phone: Enter a valid international phone number.
validation.url: Enter a valid web address using http or https.

review.title: Review your answers
review.description: Check the information below before the future submission stage.

preliminaryNotice: This document is intended solely for preliminary requirements gathering. It does not constitute a commercial offer or a binding contractual commitment. The final scope of work will be defined in the Commercial Proposal, if subsequently approved.

idle.title: Ready for final submission
idle.description: Confirm the statement above, review your answers and submit when everything is correct.

flushing.title: Saving the latest changes
flushing.description: Please wait while the latest acknowledged draft revision is secured.

submitting.title: Submitting your project brief
submitting.description: Keep this page open until CodeVivo confirms the submission.

confirmed.title: Submission confirmed
confirmed.description: Your project brief has been received.

validation-error.title: Some information needs attention
validation-error.description: Review the highlighted field before submitting again.

revision-conflict.title: A newer draft is available
revision-conflict.description: Reload the latest saved version before attempting final submission again.

idempotency-conflict.title: This submission attempt cannot be reused
idempotency-conflict.description: Reload the authoritative state before starting a deliberate new submission attempt.

ambiguous.title: Confirmation was not received
ambiguous.description: The submission may have completed. Check it again using the same protected submission attempt.

offline.title: You appear to be offline
offline.description: Reconnect before checking the same submission attempt again.

unavailable.title: This session is unavailable
unavailable.description: The submission cannot continue from this session. Contact CodeVivo if you need assistance.

confirmation.title: Project brief submitted
confirmation.description: Thank you. CodeVivo has securely received your project brief and it can no longer be edited.
confirmation.nextDescription: CodeVivo will review the information and contact you to clarify any open points and agree the next step.

navigation.unavailableStep: Complete the preceding steps before opening: {step}
